# airflow_user (List Resource)

Lists all Airflow users. Use with `terraform query` (Terraform 1.14 and later) to enumerate existing users. On Airflow 3 users are read from the auth manager API (`auth_manager_base_path`). Passwords are never returned.

## Example Usage

```terraform
list "airflow_user" "all" {
  provider         = airflow
  include_resource = true
}
```
